sources.title: roberta-base: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: The models are architecturally identical but differ completely in vocabulary and learned representations due to training on different languages. kf-deberta-base by kakaobank is a Korean language model using the DeBERTa architecture from Microsoft rather than RoBERTa.
